mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate indicates tight monetary policy, leading to decreased corporate borrowing and investment, which negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If SPX shows positive 20-day returns despite high FEDFUNDS, hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are positive when UNRATE exceeds 4%, hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth alongside rising unemployment may indicate structural issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If returns are positive despite mixed labor signals, hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Peaking industrial production in late-cycle expansion signals upcoming slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If returns are positive during late-cycle with peaking INDPRO, hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Growing real sales indicate strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are negative despite RSAFS growth, hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid industrial production growth signals supply constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If returns are positive after rapid INDPRO growth, hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate coupled with low GDP indicates stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If returns are positive despite high FEDFUNDS and low GDPC1, hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rate indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are negative with low UNRATE, hypothesis fails.
